groups.name: app.sftp
groups.description: Ingestion polling config. The sftp prefix is retained for deployment compatibility; actual transport is S3-backed.

properties.name: app.client-service-url
properties.description: URL of the client service

properties.name: app.jwt.hmac-secret
properties.description: HMAC secret for JWT token signing and validation

properties.name: app.jwt.auth-mode
properties.description: Authentication token validation mode. Supported values: local, hybrid, cognito.

properties.name: app.jwt.cognito.issuer
properties.description: Expected Cognito issuer URL for RS256 token validation.

properties.name: app.jwt.cognito.audience
properties.description: Expected Cognito app client ID used as token audience/client_id.

properties.name: app.jwt.cognito.jwks-url
properties.description: Cognito JWKS endpoint URL used to resolve RSA verification keys.

properties.name: app.jwt.cognito.jwks-cache-ttl-seconds
properties.description: JWKS cache TTL in seconds for Cognito key refresh.

properties.name: app.mock-sftp.root
properties.description: Root directory for mock SFTP server

properties.name: app.sftp.host
properties.description: Configured SFTP host

properties.name: app.sftp.port
properties.description: Configured SFTP port

properties.name: app.sftp.username
properties.description: Configured SFTP username

properties.name: app.sftp.password
properties.description: Configured SFTP password

properties.name: app.sftp.private-key-path
properties.description: Configured SFTP private key path

properties.name: app.sftp.remote-dir
properties.description: Remote directory polled for CSV files

properties.name: app.sftp.poll.enabled
properties.description: Enable scheduled transaction import polling

properties.name: app.sftp.poll.fixed-delay-ms
properties.description: Scheduled poll fixed delay in milliseconds

properties.name: app.sftp.poll.initial-delay-ms
properties.description: Scheduled poll initial delay in milliseconds

properties.name: app.import-s3.bucket
properties.description: Optional S3 bucket used as import source for mock SFTP ingestion

properties.name: app.import-s3.region
properties.description: AWS region used by the S3 import client

properties.name: app.import-s3.endpoint
properties.description: Optional S3 endpoint override (for example LocalStack)

properties.name: app.import-s3.path-style-access-enabled
properties.description: Use S3 path-style access

properties.name: app.import-s3.access-key-id
properties.description: Optional static access key for S3 import client

properties.name: app.import-s3.secret-access-key
properties.description: Optional static secret key for S3 import client
